$comment: The four causes that got real submissions rejected. DATA, not code — changing a rule is a pull request against this file, reviewable by someone who does not write C#.

rules.description: Manifest version and assembly version must match the expected pattern.
rules.failureMessage: Version format mismatch between manifest and assembly.

rules.description: Entitlement claimed in the .addin must match the configured entitlement.
rules.failureMessage: Claimed entitlement differs from configured entitlement.

rules.description: Installer requested privilege level must match the declared configuration.
rules.failureMessage: Installer privilege level does not match the declared configuration.

rules.description: The privacy-policy URL must resolve. One missing character has cost a full review cycle.
